title: SegFormer
description: NVIDIA's SegFormer: a transformer for ADE20K scene segmentation (sizes B0 and B5), plus two community fine-tunes: clothes parsing (B2, 18 classes) and face parsing (B5, 19…
html:
NVIDIA's SegFormer: a transformer for ADE20K scene segmentation (sizes B0 and B5), plus two community fine-tunes: clothes parsing (B2, 18 classes) and face parsing (B5, 19 classes). Non-commercial weights.

Commercial use: segformer-b0-ade20k, segformer-b5-ade20k, segformer-b2-clothes: no (weights: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-Source-Code-License-NC); segformer-b5-face-parsing: no (weights: LicenseRef-noncommercial).

Details
  • Paper: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers, NeurIPS 2021, 2021-05-31
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers at c4c4605f9618
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/NVlabs/SegFormer (PyTorch): The authors' code needs mmsegmentation; the transformers port is self-contained.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-Source-Code-License-NC
    • segformer-b5-face-parsing: LicenseRef-noncommercial
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/segformer-b0-finetuned-ade-512-512/blob/489d5cd81a0b59fab9b7ea758d3548ebe99677da/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification), ADE20K (SceneParsing, 150 classes)
    • segformer-b2-clothes: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification), ATR human parsing dataset (18 clothes / body-part classes; SegFormer-B2 clothes: Hugging Face mirror mattmdjaga/human_parsing_dataset)
    • segformer-b5-face-parsing: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification), CelebAMask-HQ (30 000 CelebA-HQ faces, 19 face-part masks)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3, seg_up
  • Variants: segformer-b0-ade20k, segformer-b5-ade20k, segformer-b2-clothes, segformer-b5-face-parsing
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: ade20k-150
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): segformer-b0-ade20k 3000x4000 (3.8 GiB peak allocated, 4.0 reserved); segformer-b5-ade20k 3000x4000 (4.0 GiB peak allocated, 4.3 reserved); segformer-b2-clothes 3000x4000 (0.6 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved); segformer-b5-face-parsing 3000x4000 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.9 reserved)
  • segformer-b0-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 12 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 61 s (ONNX + engine).
  • segformer-b5-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 34 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 84 s (ONNX + engine).
  • segformer-b2-clothes 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 18 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 63 s (ONNX + engine).
  • segformer-b5-face-parsing 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 35 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • segformer-b0-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • segformer-b5-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • segformer-b2-clothes original (fp32) 512x512: transformers SegformerForSemanticSegmentation, logits upsampled bilinear + argmax, float32; pinned transformers checkpoint
  • segformer-b2-clothes original 512x512: transformers SegformerForSemanticSegmentation, logits upsampled bilinear + argmax, .half(); pinned transformers checkpoint
  • segformer-b5-face-parsing original (fp32) 512x512: transformers SegformerForSemanticSegmentation, logits upsampled bilinear + argmax, float32; pinned transformers checkpoint
  • segformer-b5-face-parsing original 512x512: transformers SegformerForSemanticSegmentation, logits upsampled bilinear + argmax, .half(); pinned transformers checkpoint
  • segformer-b0-ade20k load / first call: original 4.83 s / 2.232 s (512x512), portable 2.55 s / 0.082 s, kernels 2.92 s / 0.009 s
  • segformer-b5-ade20k load / first call: original 1.24 s / 0.501 s (512x512), portable 3.09 s / 0.077 s, kernels 3.43 s / 0.032 s
  • segformer-b2-clothes load / first call: portable 3.72 s / 0.245 s (512x512), kernels 3.65 s / 0.062 s (512x512)
  • segformer-b5-face-parsing load / first call: portable 4.16 s / 0.228 s (512x512), kernels 4.87 s / 0.093 s (512x512)
  • Protocol, segformer-b0-ade20k, segformer-b5-ade20k: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5 (tools/speed_check.py), synthetic CUDA input (bench_inputs); peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
  • Protocol, segformer-b2-clothes, segformer-b5-face-parsing: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5
